plan: A fighter who soaks up hits then sends them back with a huge punch.
aSurveiller: His W (Haymaker). The more damage he has taken, the stronger the punch, and its centre deals true damage: don't stand in the middle.
contrer: Stop hitting him when his gauge is full: he's about to send that damage back with his W.
Don't surround him: his E stuns enemies if there are some on both sides of him.
Spread out in fights: his R slams a champion and damages everyone around the impact.
forces: Very strong early and in duels.
Soaks up then returns damage with his W.
His R can start a fight.
faiblesses: Few ways to close the gap.
His big punch (W) is easy to see coming.

sorts.P: Alternates punches and regenerates based on missing health.
sorts.Q: His next 2 attacks hurt more and he runs towards enemies.
sorts.W: Shield and huge punch, stronger if he has taken damage.
sorts.E: Pulls in enemies on both sides and stuns them.
sorts.R: Grabs a champion and slams them into the ground.

momentFort: Strong from the first levels, and very dangerous from level 6.
